scope_caveat: Local optimum over the explicitly tested candidate pool only; not a mathematical or global proof of optimality.

authority.note: PASS covers only the 7 complete configurations in the pool (raw baseline, canonical export with the Lutri companion outside the 100, preferred six, five-swap floor without Mana Drain, Pass C's Resonator-over-Wake six-swap, and two seven-swap alternatives) plus named single-card contenders. They were judged with finite current-Oracle rules cases, Commander Spellbook combo lookups and a quantity-counted mana comparison. Tests run locally and in .github/workflows/m7-bjorna-nightfall-alchemist-cecily.yml; run URLs are recorded in the PR body. There is no statistical multiplayer ranking. The A/B seals and the owner-equivalent Pass C are historical, baseline-scoped and not technically independent. Lutri as companion, Trade Secrets and Yawgmoth's Bargain remain project exceptions for this deck only. Nothing here implies owner approval, M6 certification, M7 approval or a canonical change.
